name: 갈림길 나무 이정표(글자 없는 화살 판)
label: gothic_manor/gm-signpost

answer.main_body: wooden signpost (vertical post with horizontal arrow boards)
answer.evidence: The post and attached horizontal sign planks are drawn in a flat 2D side-scroller / front elevation style. The top of the post has vertical cylinder shading with no top cut surface or cross-section visible, and the horizontal planks show only 1px edge highlights rather than visible top surfaces.

The signboards (horizontal beams) are drawn entirely in front elevation with only a 1px edge highlight along their tops (rows 6, 12, 18), rather than showing foreshortened top surfaces. The vertical post also lacks a distinct 3/4 cut face, rendering the object as a flat front view.

The top cut face of the vertical post is rendered at rows 1-3 (3 source pixels tall), uniformly highlighted across its full width without the vertical shaft's side shadow that begins below it at row 4. The stone base also shows a top surface.

The top cut face of the wooden post is clearly visible at rows 1-3 (3px tall) with lighter coloration than the front shaft face below it. The stone base and directional planks also display foreshortened top surfaces consistent with 3/4 view.
